programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Tortura en México
programme.desc: Fueron interrogados, y pronto, las preguntas se convirtieron en golpes. El drama de quienes han sufrido la tortura en carne propia, y también, un ex militar justifica sus acciones.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Alas del narco
programme.desc: El drama de las misteriosas desapariciones de pilotos y los riesgos a los que se exponen en las selvas andinas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Deportaciones masivas: Miedo y realidad
programme.desc: El miedo a las deportaciones masivas, dentro de las comunidades latinas, aumentó después de nuevas reglas anunciadas para la expulsión de inmigrantes indocumentados. Los inmigrantes están cansados de vivir en la ansiedad y han decidido auto deportarse.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Inmigración: Las nuevas reglas
programme.desc: Las recientes redadas de inmigración en varios estados de la nación han despertado el temor en muchas comunidades. Familias trabajadoras están pensando dos veces antes de salir a su empleo o enviar los niños a la escuela.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Traicionados por la justicia
programme.desc: Alrededor de cincuenta jóvenes de un mismo vecindario recibieron acusaciones de homicidios que los marcaron para siempre. Algunos pasaron décadas en prisión, otros están aún intentando limpiar sus nombres.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - En la boca del lobo
programme.desc: En medio de las tensiones raciales de los últimos meses, Ilia Calderón se adentra en el mundo del grupo supremacista blanco Ku Klux Klan y entrevista a uno de sus líderes. El encuentro está lleno de amenazas e insultos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La amenaza de la amapola
programme.desc: En los campos de la Sierra de Guerrero, México, florecen la amapola y la violencia. Familias campesinas se ganan la vida con los cultivos ilegales, mientras que los carteles de la droga buscan controlar el mercado.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Ángeles y Demonios
programme.desc: Salmo 100 es una organización que lleva mensajes de paz y reconciliación. Las historias de Daniel, Adrián o Giovanni son ejemplos que usa Salmo 100 para ayudar a más personas que quieren salir del mundo del crimen organizado en la frontera.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Doble vida
programme.desc: De día es un estudiante universitario, de noche bailarín exótico. Para unos era su guía espiritual, para otros era un peligro para su comunidad.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Burlando la muerte
programme.desc: Personas que por diferentes razones del destino han estado al borde de la muerte, pero han recibido una segunda oportunidad para continuar con sus vidas. Desde accidentes con puentes desplomados, ataques por celos, sobrevivientes de terremotos y más.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Magnates de Dios
programme.desc: Se han convertido en emporios religiosos multinacionales donde van de la mano el dinero y la fe, un negocio multimillonario, pastores y predicadores evangélicos que llevan vidas opulentas. Tienen problemas con la autoridad por diversas denuncias.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Muerte río arriba
programme.desc: La vida tranquila de un pueblo fue afectada por ataques inesperados. Una lancha con 16 pasajeros sufrió el peor destino que pudieran imaginar. Wilmer cuenta la pesadilla que vivió cuando agentes de la DEA confunden la embarcación en la que iba.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Caminando al borde
programme.desc: Miles de migrantes que han sido recibidos entre hostilidad y protestas en la frontera sur deberán enfrentar una nueva realidad, pero la esperanza los acompaña. El camino para llegar a Estados Unidos es muy peligroso.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Chicos malos
programme.desc: Una nueva generación de artistas del género urbano domina las listas de éxito a nivel mundial. Las letras de sus canciones están plagadas de violencia, crimen, sexo y drogas que se han convertido en una multimillonaria industria.

programme.desc: Jennifer Brooks has spent her life answering the call to serve. From flying Blackhawk helicopters on multiple combat missions during two tours in Iraq to now serving as an Air Medical Pilot and first responder, her story is one of courage, sacrifice, and humility. In this episode of Storytellers, we join Jennifer in the field for a hunt that offers a rare moment to slow down, reflect, and honor a life dedicated to protecting others.

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: The Raven Project

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: The Journey Within - "Eastern Cape of South Africa: Cape Bushbuck"
programme.desc: Mark Peterson's South African journey continues as he travels deeper into the rugged terrain of the Eastern Cape. In this episode, he is in pursuit of one of Africa’s most challenging and elusive plains game species, the Cape Bushbuck. Known for their ability to vanish into thick vegetation at the first sign of danger, hunting these "ghosts of the bush" requires extreme patience and precision. Join the crew as they navigate the dense brush and steep hillsides, battling shifting winds and thick cover to find a mature ram.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: The Journey Within - "Hunting Anatolian Chamois in Turkey With Mark Peterson"
programme.desc: Mark Peterson heads out on a unique hunt for the rare Anatolian Chamois, a mountain dweller found in the high elevations of northern Turkey. With a storm rolling in, Mark hopes the weather will push the Chamois down from their usual heights, giving him a rare chance to track this prey across the challenging landscape.

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God’s protection and Derek’s assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek’s own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: Passport to Love

programme.title: Hot Chocolate Holiday
programme.desc: Colette runs a coffee shop that is home to her secret and famous hot chocolate recipe. She finds herself in competition with Marcus, the kind, new dessert shop owner who draws her customers away with his own specialty hot chocolate. Colette thinks he stole her recipe but she gives him a chance when his store suffers damage from a fire and has to close. Colette works together with him to repair his shop but it might not be enough to get him back on his feet in time for Christmas. It will, however, help Colette see Marcus in a different light, especially as she learns the source of his hot chocolate recipe. Love, hot chocolate and an unexpected connection will bring Marcus and Colette together for the holidays.

programme.title: The New Gladiators
programme.desc: The Troma Team is proud to present a classic take on the future of entertainment from the master of Italian splatter, Lucio Fulci (THE BEYOND, ZOMBIE). Tomorrows TV is bigger, badder and bloodier than your wildest expectations in THE NEW GLADIATORS!!! Blaxploitation star Fred Williamson (BLACK CAESAR, FROM DUSK TILL DAWN) and Jared Martin star in this violent sci-fi satire pitting criminals as contestants battling each other for the most precious prizetheir lives! Martin plays Blake, a gladiator on TVs hottest program Thrillkill, a deadly tournament where there is only one victor and many victims. The plot thickens when Blake decides to retire, prompting the shows-ratings hungry producer, Cortez (Claudio Cassinelli) to frame Blake for a crime he didnt commit. And in the future the only way to prove your innocence is by proving you can stay alive in the Battle of the Damned. Fulci bars no holds with his signature extreme style, including slow motion throat slashings, close-up body crushings and the most brutal battle sequences this side of Braveheart! Preceding the RUNNING MAN by three years and proving once again that he is The Godfather of Gore, director Lucio Fulci you his epic vision of the future entertainment in a futuristic society. programme.title: The New Gladiators
programme.desc: The Troma Team is proud to present a classic take on the future of entertainment from the master of Italian splatter, Lucio Fulci (THE BEYOND, ZOMBIE). Tomorrows TV is bigger, badder and bloodier than your wildest expectations in THE NEW GLADIATORS!!! Blaxploitation star Fred Williamson (BLACK CAESAR, FROM DUSK TILL DAWN) and Jared Martin star in this violent sci-fi satire pitting criminals as contestants battling each other for the most precious prizetheir lives! Martin plays Blake, a gladiator on TVs hottest program Thrillkill, a deadly tournament where there is only one victor and many victims. The plot thickens when Blake decides to retire, prompting the shows-ratings hungry producer, Cortez (Claudio Cassinelli) to frame Blake for a crime he didnt commit. And in the future the only way to prove your innocence is by proving you can stay alive in the Battle of the Damned. Fulci bars no holds with his signature extreme style, including slow motion throat slashings, close-up body crushings and the most brutal battle sequences this side of Braveheart! Preceding the RUNNING MAN by three years and proving once again that he is The Godfather of Gore, director Lucio Fulci you his epic vision of the future entertainment in a futuristic society. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old.
